question: Which district has more paved road per 1,000 residents in 2025, Coldharbour or Stonecairn, and by how many km per 1,000 residents?

samples.text:
Facts used:
- Coldharbour’s 2025 population was 11,407 residents and its paved road network was 598.3 km. [NR-12]
- Stonecairn’s 2025 population was 14,926 residents and its paved road network was 506.8 km. [NR-06]

Calculation:
- Coldharbour: \(598.3 \div 11,407 \times 1,000 = 52.445\) km per 1,000 residents.
- Stonecairn: \(506.8 \div 14,926 \times 1,000 = 33.957\) km per 1,000 residents.
- Difference: \(52.445 - 33.957 = 18.488\) km per 1,000 residents.

Coldharbour has more paved road per 1,000 residents, by 18.488 km per 1,000 residents.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 18.488
